claims.scope: For each fixed polynomially bounded polynomial-time verifier relation, a correct decision oracle and a fixed polynomial prefix-language reduction give a uniform search algorithm with at most p(n)+1queries. Ordinary polynomial search remains conditional on an ordinary polynomial decider.
claims.assurance: Analytic proof audit; no executed complexity research instrument.

claims.scope: There exists a decidable binary language outside uniform Pwith constant functions/two noninput gates at every positive length. A uniform polynomial unary-length circuit generator would instead give a polynomial decider. No NPmembership or PversusNPseparation is claimed.
claims.assurance: Analytic proof audit; no executed complexity research instrument.

claims.scope: For the exact unary-clock/program oracle Adefined here, ordinaryEXP=P^A=NP^A. This single-oracle known theorem does not imply ordinaryP=NP, P!=NP, EXP^A=EXP, or a new barrier for a submitted proof.
claims.assurance: Analytic proof audit; no executed complexity research instrument.
